results.rationale: Both milk-filled glasses remain in the same setting with only a small shift of the right glass. Red laser light enters from the left and extends toward the right through both cups. However, a dominant glowing orb between the glasses and strong vertical red streaks obscure the expected simple transmitted beam. This unexplained luminous center is also a conspicuous naturalness flaw despite coherent glass geometry.

The braided trunk, leaf arrangement and woven pot are preserved. The poster adds a pale green gradient and halo, floating droplets and leaf silhouettes, and the exact Green Home title at upper left. The plant, decorative elements and legible lettering form a coherent, clean composition.
